scripts.build: pnpm -w run generate:changelog && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.e2e: pnpm -w run generate:changelog && playwright test --config playwright.e2e.config.ts
scripts.screenshots: pnpm -w run generate:changelog && pnpm --filter @zakka/editor-core build && pnpm --filter @zakka/api-contract build && pnpm screenshots:capture
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -w run generate:changelog && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
